priority_outcomes: Resolve or improve sentiment in open workflow support case
non_negotiables: Use only email channel for outreach
Leverage usage personalisation allowed by preference profile
Do not infer protected traits or vulnerability
Do not require knowledge of the exact workflow cause to act
success_signals: Month-over-month increase in feature adoption metric
Month-over-month increase in active users count
Resolution or sentiment improvement in open workflow support case

design_thesis: A spatial email doorway leads to a quiet, inspectable signal garden where customers encounter their account's usage patterns as tangible, non-judgmental strands. By revealing aggregate signals without interpretation, the experience invites reflection and optional clarification, honoring agency while surfacing potential friction through self-paced discovery.

experience_principles.name: Evidence Grounding
experience_principles.rationale: Every interactive element must bind directly to a cited evidence key, preventing invention or inference beyond the ResearchBrief.

experience_principles.name: Consent as Continuity
experience_principles.rationale: Email is a doorway, not the experience; any clarification sought in the web experience is optional, purpose-limited, and not persisted without explicit consent.

experience_principles.name: Agency Over Persuasion
experience_principles.rationale: The design avoids dark patterns, urgency theatre, and forced continuity, instead offering dignified paths to inspect, question, or exit.

experience_principles.name: Accessible by Default
experience_principles.rationale: Motion, contrast, focus, and reduced motion must meet WCAG 2.2 AA to ensure the experience is usable by all.

recovery_concept.name: Signal Garden
recovery_concept.one_line_promise: Inspect your team's usage signals without pressure, and choose whether to explore workflow clarity.

journey.title: Email Threshold
journey.customer_goal: Recognise a trusted, consent-safe invitation to reflect on usage patterns.
journey.system_response: A concise, branded email arrives with subject 'Your Copper signal garden metaphor. The body copy: 'See your signals. The email is a single sentence: Your team's usage signals' and body: 'We've noticed shifts in how your team uses Finch Copper. No action needed—just an open door to inspect your signals if curious. [Open Signal Garden]'. The button links to the Recovery Room with a single-use, non-tracking token.
journey.consent_check: Email outreach is permitted by preference profile; the email contains no persuasion, only an invitation to a self-guided inspection.
maker_acceptance_criteria: Email sent matches approved copy and uses only allowed channel
Link directs to Recovery Room loading state with valid token
Email contains no automated sequence triggers or secondary calls to action

journey.title: Loading State
journey.customer_goal: Understand that the experience is preparing their personal signal garden.
journey.system_response: The Recovery Room loads with a soft-focus background of growing lines. A circular progress indicator shows 'Preparing your signal garden...' with ARIA label 'Loading signal garden, please wait'. No decorative animation plays; motion is limited to the determinate progress bar.
journey.consent_check: No customer data is accessed or displayed yet; the state is purely presentational.
maker_acceptance_criteria: Component renders with role='progressbar' and aria-valuetext
No infinite loops or autoplay animation
Reduced-motion media query replaces progress bar with static text 'Loading...'

journey.title: Ready State
journey.customer_goal: Orient to the signal garden and understand what can be inspected.
journey.system_response: The interface resolves into a calm 2D canvas. Three signal strands appear: Feature Adoption (41.04% → 29.08%), Active Users (141 → 120), Session Frequency (3.77 → 4.85). Each strand is a horizontal bar with labelled current and previous values, sourced directly from evidence. Seat Utilisation (75.95%) appears as a standalone signal card. A subtle hint reads: 'Inspect any signal to learn more. No action required.' Focus proceeds through the canvas, then to the persistent exit and page navigation.
journey.consent_check: All displayed values are direct citations from evidence; no interpretation or aggregation beyond what is provided.
maker_acceptance_criteria: Each signal strand binds to its evidence key and shows exact values
Seat utilisation card displays only the cited percentage
Focus order is logical and continues to the persistent exit and page navigation
Contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.2 AA for text and interactive elements

journey.title: Active Inspection
journey.customer_goal: Examine a signal's detail and optionally seek clarification about workflow friction.
journey.system_response: When a signal strand receives focus (via click, keyboard, or screen reader), it expands to reveal a tooltip: 'This shows change over the last 30 days. Values come from your account snapshot.' For the open support case, a separate inspectable element appears: 'One open medium-severity workflow support case exists (case reference: support:copper-finch:2-1). Sentiment: -0.267 (negative). Unresolved as of 2026-07-27.' A button labelled 'Clarify workflow friction?' appears below inspected signals. If
journey.consent_check: The clarification request is optional, purpose-limited to understanding workflow friction, and not persisted without explicit consent in a later step.
maker_acceptance_criteria: Expanded view shows exact citation and values from evidence
Support case element displays only the cited case reference, sentiment, and date
Clarification button is not pre-selected and requires explicit action
No data is stored or transmitted upon button focus alone

journey.title: Clarification Choice
journey.customer_goal: Decide whether to share a workflow observation to help improve the product.
journey.system_response: If the customer activates the 'Clarify workflow friction?' button, a modal appears: 'Help us understand: Is there a specific workflow step where things feel stuck? Your response is optional and will not be used beyond improving this signal garden.' With fields: 'Optional observation (text area)' and buttons ['Share observation', 'Not now']. Choosing 'Share observation' sends the observation to a consent-logged endpoint; 'Not now' closes the modal. The modal traps focus and announces its purpose.
journey.consent_check: The observation is explicitly optional, not required to proceed, and bound to the support case evidence as its subject domain. Persistence only occurs with explicit 'Share observation' action.
maker_acceptance_criteria: Modal has role='dialog' and aria-modal='true'
Observation field is not required and has no default value
'Share observation' button triggers API call only on explicit click
'Not now' button dismisses modal without side effects
Reduced-motion media query disables modal animation

journey.title: Success State
journey.customer_goal: Feel acknowledged for engaging with their signals, regardless of outcome.
journey.system_response: After inspecting signals or closing the clarification modal, a banner appears: 'Thank you for exploring your signal garden. Your team's patterns are yours to act on—or not.' The banner has ARIA status 'info' and fades out after 5 seconds unless reduced motion is preferred. No further action is suggested.
journey.consent_check: The message acknowledges agency and does not imply a recommended path or create obligation.
maker_acceptance_criteria: Banner has role='status' and aria-live='polite'
Message contains no persuasion, urgency, or next-step suggestion
Banner respects reduced-motion preferences with static fallback

content_architecture.label: Main inspection area
content_architecture.purpose: Displays aggregate signal strands and support case as inspect-only objects

content_architecture.label: Optional workflow clarification
content_architecture.purpose: Captures purpose-limited, consent-gated observation about workflow friction

content_architecture.label: Post-interaction acknowledgment
content_architecture.purpose: Thanks customer for engagement without prescribing action

permission_moments.customer_control: Opt-in via preference profile; email is a one-way invitation
permission_moments.decline_path: Do not engage with email; no further contact implied

permission_moments.customer_control: Explicit button activation required to enter modal
permission_moments.decline_path: 'Not now' button or modal dismiss via escape/overlay click

additional_safety_patterns: All captured data is ephemeral unless explicit consent is given for sharing observation
No data from signal inspection is stored or used for profiling
The experience never infers causality between signals or suggests diagnostic conclusions

keyboard: Tab and Shift+Tab navigate between signal strands, clarification button, and modal controls
Enter/Space activates focused button or expands signal strand
Escape closes modal and returns focus to trigger
Arrow keys navigate within modal form fields in clarification modal
screen_reader: All signal strands have role='img' with aria-label describing the signal and its values
Clarification button has accessible name 'Clarify workflow friction?'
Modal has role='dialog', aria-labelledby, and aria-describedby
Live regions use aria-live='polite' for status updates
Images of signals use meaningful text alternatives; no reliance on color alone
visual: Minimum contrast ratio 4.5:1 for text, 3:1 for UI components
Focus indicators are visible and have 2px solid outline in brand color
Text scales to 200% without loss of content or function
Color is never used as the sole means of conveying information
reduced_motion: Respects prefers-reduced-motion: replaces all non-essential animation with static states
Modal and banner appear without transition
Signal expansion is instant without animation

motion_language.intent: Motion communicates causality and state change, never decoration
transitions: Entry: determinate progress bar to signal canvas (no loop)
Focus: signal strand expands to show detail (causality: user action reveals information)
Choice: clarification modal appears with scale-fade (state: optional interaction initiated)
Exit: acknowledgment banner fades or appears static (state: interaction complete)
motion_language.reduced_motion_fallback: All motion-triggered changes become instant state shifts; no animation plays

measurement_plan.signal: Month-over-month increase in feature adoption metric
measurement_plan.interpretation: An increase suggests the recovery experience may have encouraged re-engagement with underutilised features.
measurement_plan.source_success_signal: Month-over-month increase in feature adoption metric
measurement_plan.guardrail: No individual user tracking; metric remains account-level aggregate

measurement_plan.signal: Month-over-month increase in active users count
measurement_plan.interpretation: An increase suggests the experience may have supported broader team re-engagement.
measurement_plan.source_success_signal: Month-over-month increase in active users count
measurement_plan.guardrail: No individual user tracking; metric remains account-level aggregate

measurement_plan.signal: Resolution or sentiment improvement in open workflow support case
measurement_plan.interpretation: Resolution or sentiment improvement suggests the clarification interaction may have surfaced actionable feedback.
measurement_plan.source_success_signal: Resolution or sentiment improvement in open workflow support case
measurement_plan.guardrail: No case details are stored; observation sharing is explicit and purpose-limited

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Customer may perceive signal inspection as judgment despite neutral framing
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Signal strands are labelled as observational data with explicit 'No action required' messaging; tone is curious, not corrective.
risks_and_mitigations.escalation_trigger: If qualitative feedback indicates perceived judgment, pause and revisit tone.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Optional clarification could feel like a soft sell
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Clarification request is framed as helping improve the signal garden itself, not the product; observation field is optional and not required to proceed.
risks_and_mitigations.escalation_trigger: If customers report feeling pressured, remove or rephrase the clarification prompt.

build_order: Create SignalStrand component to render cited aggregate signals with current/previous values
Build SignalCanvas to layout strands and seat utilisation card with logical tab order
Implement LoadingState with determinate progress bar and reduced-motion fallback
Develop ReadyState to initialize canvas with evidence-bound signals
Add ActiveInspection logic to expand strands and show support case detail on focus
Create ClarificationModal with optional observation field and explicit consent actions
Implement SuccessState with acknowledgment banner and polite live region
Wire state transitions: loading → ready → active → (clarification optional) → success/declined/error
Apply WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, focus, keyboard, and screen-reader standards
Validate all data bindings cite exact evidence keys and values
